[SWS_CRYPT_03302]
{DRAFT}
Key agreement
⌈
The interface
ara::crypto::
cryp::KeyAgreementPrivateCtx::AgreeKey
shall execute the key agreement
scheme specified at the creation of this context using the provided
ara::crypto::
cryp::PublicKey
and return a non-exportable, non-storable instance of
ara::
crypto::cryp::SymmetricKey
. The returned
ara::crypto::cryp::Symmet-
ricKey
shall be restricted according to the provided allowed usage flags as well as to
the provided
ara::crypto::CryptoAlgId
. The interface shall return
•
kUninitializedContext
, if
ara::crypto::cryp::KeyAgreementPri-
vateCtx::SetKey
was not successfully called before.
•
kIncompatibleObject
, if the provided
ara::crypto::cryp::PublicKey
belongs to a different
ara::crypto::cryp::CryptoProvider
instance.
